topic: PP 20/2026 — who keeps the 0.5% UMKM tax and who loses it

slides.headline: The 0.5% tax just changed owners
slides.body: Indonesia rewrote its most popular small-business tax in April 2026. Individuals win. Companies get a deadline.

slides.headline: Not dead. Re-assigned.
slides.body: The 0.5% final tax (PPh Final UMKM) survives — but its audience changed. Individual entrepreneurs keep it with NO time limit. Regular companies can no longer enter the scheme.

slides.headline: Who keeps it, who loses it
slides.body: KEEPS: individuals (permanent, first IDR 500M tax-free) · PT Perorangan · koperasi. LOSES going forward: multi-shareholder PT · CV · Firma · BUMDes.

slides.headline: Already inside? You're grandfathered
slides.body: Registered before PP 20/2026? You finish your original window: PT = 3 fiscal years, CV/Firma = 4, counted from registration. A 2026 PT runs to 2028. A 2024 PT exits at the end of 2026. One date decides everything: your NPWP registration.

slides.headline: The math nobody shows you
slides.body: The 0.5% taxes REVENUE. The normal regime taxes PROFIT — at ~11% effective for small companies (Art 31E discount). Margin under ~4.5%? The normal regime is CHEAPER. Loss year? You pay zero, not 0.5% of everything.

slides.headline: Find your exit year before it finds you
slides.statement: One registration date decides your tax for the next three years. Bali Zero runs the full check — window, margin math, transition calendar.
